content: अवरोधः .²1 Hindrance, obstruction; फेनायमानं स्रोतोऽवरोधः <ls>Suśr.</ls> .²2 Restraint; अन्तःप्राणावरोध <ls>Mk. 1. 1</ls>. .²3 Inner apartments or womenʼs apartments, harem, seraglio; निन्ये विनीतैरवरोधदक्षैः <ls>Ku. 7. 73</ls>; <ls>Śi. 5. 7</ls>; अवरोधजनः <ls>K. 57</ls>; ˚गृहेषु राज्ञः <ls>Ś. 5. 3</ls>, <ls n="Ś.">6. 12</ls>. .²4 The wives of a king taken collectively (<ab>oft.</ab> <ab>pl.</ab>); अवरोधे महत्यपि <ls>R. 1. 32</ls>, <ls n="R.">4. 68</ls>, <ls n="R. 4.">87</ls>, also यस्यावरोधस्तनचन्दनानां प्रक्षालनाद्वारिविहारकाले <ls n="R.">6. 48</ls>, <ls n="R.">16. 58</ls>, <ls>Mv. 6. 20</ls>. .²5 An enclosure, confinement. .²6 Siege, investment, blockade; दुर्गावरोधः <ls>H. 3</ls>. .²7 A covering, lid. .²8 A fence, a pen. .²9 A watchman. .²10 Depression, hollow. .²11 Layer (plant) see under अवरुह्. .²12 Procuring; प्रजानन्दामृतावरोधेन गृहेषु लोकं नियमयत् <ls>Bhāg. 5. 4. 14</ls>. <ab>cf.</ab> अवरोधस्तिरोधाने राजदारेषु तद्गृहे <ls>Nm.</ls>
अवरोधः .²1 Moving down, descending. .²2 A shoot sent up by the root of a plant; a slip (for planting); the pendent shoots of the (Indian) fig-tree.
